fontes.organizacao: UK Department for Transport / Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency
fontes.titulo: df_VEH0160_UK — Vehicles registered for the first time by body type, make, generic model, model and fuel
fontes.cobertura: BodyType Cars only; all generic models and fuels; separate full annual aggregates and published quarters
fontes.limitacoes: First UK registrations include imported vehicles, including previously used imports. Not equivalent to SMMT new-car sales. Administrative make/model errors and missing generic-model categories are preserved. Quarterly data must never be interpolated to months. Prices and SUV/sedan/hatch segments absent.
